questions.q: Exam practice: (a) Calculate the difference between primary and tertiary employment in the example data. (1) (b) Explain two reasons for the decline of primary employment in developed countries. (4) (c) Assess the impact of informal employment in a named megacity. (8)
questions.a: (a) 35 percentage points (b) mechanisation; cheaper imports; growth of better-paid jobs elsewhere (c) balanced assessment with case detail and judgement

questions.q: Compare Malthus and Boserup in two sentences.
questions.a: Malthus: population outgrows food, causing crisis; Boserup: pressure drives invention and more food

questions.q: Using the example data, describe the employment structure.
questions.a: Primary is largest at 60% (1); secondary smallest at 15%, tertiary 25% (1)
questions.model: Largest sector with data. Smallest with data. Use figures.
